metadata.character_rules: A young man in his 20s with long, dark straight hair braided in two sections framing his intense green eyes, wearing a large conical straw hat. He dons a distressed, dark olive green kimono-style tunic with darker green trim, a multi-wrapped reddish-brown obi with tassels, baggy dark brown pants, and matching leg wraps with sandals. He carries a sword with a golden hilt. Core colors are earthy greens and browns with golden accents.

scenes.text: Có những nơi tồn tại không phải để soi sáng, mà để canh giữ một bí mật nào đó. Giống như ngọn hải đăng cô độc này.
scenes.image_prompt: In a 2D dark anime cartoon style, hand-drawn 2D animation style, flat cel shading, classic Japanese anime line art, eerie abandoned atmosphere, high contrast, cinematic moody lighting, no photorealism, no 3D elements, no realistic textures. Colors strictly unified: deep sepia, swamp green, and pale ghostly teal. Clean line art, portrait aspect ratio 9:16. A tall, ancient, decrepit lighthouse stands isolated on a rocky outcrop, shrouded in thick, pale ghostly teal fog. The structure is made of dark sepia stone, with cracked walls and broken windows. The overall atmosphere is desolate and mysterious, under a swamp green sky. A faint, gloomy yellowish-orange light emanates from the lantern room. In the foreground, an old man wearing an old, worn charcoal grey naval coat with a high collar. Long, flowing silver-white hair partially obscuring his face. Dull, icy blue eyes with a distant gaze. The atmosphere is enveloped in blue-grey fog.

scenes.text: Người canh giữ ngọn hải đăng, với đôi mắt mờ đục nhìn ra biển đêm. Mỗi đêm, ánh đèn ấy vẫn bật.

scenes.text: Nhưng không phải để dẫn lối, mà để triệu hồi. Triệu hồi những linh hồn lạc lối dưới đáy biển sâu.
